observations.title: HYBRID_REPLAY_SOURCE_ROOT
observations.finding: The double-generation replay bound three inputs to the live repository (ledger, gate registry, external report), while nine historical normative inputs were supplied from the sealed R4 fixture source root.
observations.impact: The replay is deterministic and hash-pinned, but it is more accurately a hybrid live-bound replay than a replay using only repository-resident sources.
observations.recommendation: During I4 or a later hardening task, define a durable immutable locator or CAS entry for the complete pinned replay source root so replay does not depend on a Temp extraction.

observations.title: STALE_HISTORICAL_PT_R2_21_NARRATIVE
observations.finding: The 35-test replay preserves a historical PT-R2-21 narrative saying the external report was absent, even though the adoption package proves it was created.
observations.impact: The stale sentence does not control the test outcome; direct live-ledger evidence correctly reports 0 findings with the source map.
observations.recommendation: Do not reuse that narrative as current-state evidence in I4.

observations.title: FINAL_ZIP_SELFTEST_IS_DETACHED
observations.finding: PACKAGE_CANDIDATE_SELFTEST.json describes the pre-final 65-entry candidate. The final 72-entry ZIP self-test was generated outside the ZIP to avoid a recursive artifact.
observations.impact: No defect in the delivered ZIP; this audit directly verified the final 72-entry archive.
observations.recommendation: Keep the final ZIP hash alongside the external audit report.

limitations: The Windows repository itself was not mounted in this audit sandbox. The Git delta and execution of governance/tools/validate-status-ledger.mjs were therefore validated through sealed raw outputs, scripts, and cross-consistent evidence rather than rerun against the current workstation.
